description: Na₃OI crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃/mmc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two O and four I atoms. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.31 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-I bond distances ranging from 3.36-3.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to two equivalent O and four I atoms. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.29 Å. There are two shorter (3.33 Å) and two longer (3.36 Å) Na-I bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to six Na atoms to form ONa₆ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent INa₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₆ octahedra, faces with seven INa₁₂ cuboctahedra, and  a faceface with one ONa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. In the second O site, O is bonded to six equivalent Na atoms to form ONa₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ONa₆ octahedra and faces with eight INa₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 3°. There are two inequivalent I sites. In the first I site, I is bonded to twelve Na atoms to form INa₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with nine INa₁₂ cuboctahedra, corners with three equivalent ONa₆ octahedra, faces with seven INa₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with seven ONa₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. In the second I site, I is bonded to twelve Na atoms to form INa₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve INa₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent INa₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight ONa₆ octahedra.
